 2,000 f1 sponsorship parent company prospects 
 prepared for 
 sportfive formula 1 sponsorship sales, 19 oct 2026 (separate discovery exercise from the clay prospect-ranking project) 
 qualification 
 ultimate parent meeting any one of: valuation / market cap >= usd 1b, cumulative funding >= usd 100m, or annual revenue >= usd 100m (revenue test added 19 oct 2026 on request; revenue figures are apollo estimates). no restriction by ownership type or industry. 
 drive csv brands tab 
 brands from the friday clay export csvs on google drive that meet the same valuation / funding parameters (revenue not counted), with their wave 16 60/40 scores. these are existing-dataset brands, listed separately on request; they are not part of the parent-level master ranking. 
 apollo matches tab 
 every apollo/lusha record that matched a company already in your files but was not re-scored, with the sheet it matched. nothing from the pulls is hidden. 
 discovery sources 
 40 knowledge-research category/region briefs; apollo.io company search (total funding >= usd 100m, 3,000 records); lusha company search (total funding >= usd 100m, 1,500 records). no paid enrichment beyond the approved search pages. 
 cross-reference 
 every parent, alias, subsidiary and brand name and website checked against: old google drive master files (all worksheets), previous prospect workbooks and csvs (all worksheets, incl. the wave 16 final ranking), and the friday clay exports (all csvs). 
 categories 
 scoring 
 signals 
 colour code 
 blue row = existing formula 1 sponsorship (the parent or one of its brands currently holds an f1, f1-team or grand prix deal; see the existing f1 sponsorship column). red row = possible f1 / f1-team link to verify before outreach. amber row = preliminary (figures from memory or connector filter only). blue rows stay in every ranking and are also listed together on the existing f1 sponsors tab. 
 parameters 
 ranking and the new brands use both the original parameters (core f1 fit 40: audience overlap, commercial synergies, brand alignment, international relevance; financial evidence 20: valuation, funding, revenue) and the new sponsorship-signal parameters (fit signals 20, capacity signals 20). qualification: valuation >= usd 1b or funding >= usd 100m or revenue >= usd 100m. 
 caveats 
 valuations and funding are research-knowledge figures dated as shown (mostly late 2025 to mid 2026); "verified" in sources means re-checked against a public source on 19 oct 2026. no figure has been invented: where unknown the cell is blank and the qualification rests on the database filter.
